blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 67 in June to 56 in September (−16.4%), and it took 31.9% of the city’s 116 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 15 in June to 12 in September (−20.0%), and it took 25.7% of the city’s 35 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Nordel for detached houses in June, August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, September (a sellers’ best bet).

Established-street house lots: freehold detached houses on the established streets, with strata condos and townhomes concentrated along 84 Avenue and in the Sunstone / Delsom Crescent pocket at the south side. No City source names a predominant zone for Nordel — zoning is parcel-by-parcel.

Lot character from the zone ladder, as stated: the residential ladder runs from RS1 at a 4,000 m² subdivision minimum through RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² or 460 m², RS6 at 390 m² and RS7 at 335 m², with duplex zones RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m²; there is no RD5 zone. Urban subdivision minimums therefore run from 335 m² (RS7) to 4,000 m² (RS1/RS2/RS3) in lower-density pockets; the zone for a specific lot is confirmed on the City zoning maps. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size.

Serviced position, as the City states it: Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home, covering garbage/recycling and, where applicable, water and sewer — Nordel's established lots sit inside the City's serviced urban system on that wording ("where applicable" is the City's own qualifier; servicing for any single vacant or assembly parcel is confirmed with the City, UNCONFIRMED parcel-by-parcel here).

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR parcel in Nordel is confirmed in the research; ALR status is a property-specific check through the Agricultural Land Commission, and the west edge borders Burns Bog / Delta Nature Reserve, protected as the Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area — protected conservancy land, not buildable lot area. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Flood position: a floodplain designation for Nordel's residential streets was not confirmed in the sources read — Delta directs owners to confirm flood and development-permit status lot by lot. UNCONFIRMED at sub-area level.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats has NO land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: Nordel sub-area detached inventory 56 / solds 6 (11% ratio) and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 12 / 2 (17% ratio); North Delta community detached median $1,100,000 and attached median $622,500. Sub-area medians are UNVERIFIED (community level only).

Sunbury Terrace — 8376 Centre Street. BARE-LAND STRATA (Strata Plan NWS2806, per a directory record — secondary source): Built 1989 per current listings, which record Title to Land: Freehold Strata and describe a boutique bare-land strata community of just 12 units, designed like half-duplexes. One listing describes "no strata rules" for the complex — listing wording, not a bylaw position: UNCONFIRMED; fees, bylaws detail and any rental/pet/age restrictions are likewise UNCONFIRMED — read the filed bylaws with the Form B.
No other bare-land strata plan in Nordel was verified

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Nordel

items.t: Nordel is in North Delta, the part of the City of Delta north of Burns Bog and south of the Fraser River.

The ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area in the 2024 OCP is centred on 84 Avenue and 112 Street, running roughly from 86 Avenue toward the 82 Avenue blocks between 112/114 Streets and 116 Street, with a stated objective to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta.

Nearby areas: Annieville to the north-west, Richardson and Sunbury Park to the north, Scottsdale and Sunshine Hills Woods to the east and south-east, Burns Bog / Delta Nature Reserve at the west edge.

Main roads: Nordel Way runs east–west across the area toward the Highway 91 interchange and the Alex Fraser Bridge; 112 Street and 116 Street run north–south; 84 Avenue is the central east–west street. Transit: route 312 (Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 112 Street, with stops at Nordel Way) and route 391 (via 116 Street, also stopping at Nordel Way), both connecting to the Expo Line at Scott Road Station. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Civic core in the Social Heart: North Delta Recreation Centre, 11415 84 Avenue; North Delta Community Park, 11311 84 Avenue (pickleball, picnic tables, playgrounds, skate park, sports fields, tennis courts, trails, washrooms); George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street; North Delta Public Health Unit, 11245 84 Avenue; Delta Nature Reserve access at 10388 Nordel Court, at the west edge. Nearest hospital: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner.
Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based, with no middle-school tier.
A named shopping centre and grocery store in Nordel confirmed on an official City source: UNVERIFIED in the research.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Nordel

items.t: OCP — consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), NO lettered schedules: the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400, applies — the current OCP consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan (the North Delta Area Plan was Schedule C.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950), including the ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area in Appendix B of Bylaw No. 8400.
Subdivision + servicing requirements — servicing-bylaw position held UNCONFIRMED (Delta precedent): subdivision follows the zone ladder minimums in. Confirm requirements with the City for the parcel.

West-edge environmental diligence: the Delta Nature Reserve / Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area borders Nordel at the west edge — for lots near the Bog, check development-permit and environmental conditions early; setback or covenant surprises surface late in deals.

Bare-land strata rules (Sunbury Terrace — the BC strata block applies in full to the lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024 (Sunbury Terrace at 12 lots is inside the requirement, and as 1989 stock its report is the roof/lot-services check); minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Nordel ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. Check the parcel on ALC mapping before applying any of this.
Foreclosure geography (for any court-ordered Nordel land): 21(2)).

The Social Heart is a permit area, not just a nickname (2024 OCP): ND12's stated objective is to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta, and both active applications (LU009689, LU009611) sit inside it — lots inside the permit area carry different development expectations than the quiet interior streets, and the former North Delta Area Plan infill identification (residential infill east of 112 Street between 72 Avenue and 90 Avenue, Schedule C.1 under the repealed Bylaw No. 3950) is history, not current policy.

The west edge is a conservancy, not a future phase: Delta Nature Reserve access is at 10388 Nordel Court and Burns Bog is protected as an Ecological Conservancy Area — west-edge "land" value is view/quiet value, not expansion value.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Nordel than in June?
faq.a: In Nordel, listings of houses fell from 67 in June to 56 in September (−16.4%); condos and townhomes fell from 15 in June to 12 in September (−20.0%).

faq.q: How big is Nordel compared with the rest of North Delta?
faq.a: In September 2026, Nordel held 26.8% of the 209 houses listed in North Delta and 16.9% of the 71 condos and townhomes listed in North Delta.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Nordel from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 37 houses and 9 condos and townhomes sold in Nordel over those 4 months.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Nordel?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Nordel?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Is there a vacant lot subdivision I can buy into in Nordel?
faq.a: No verified one — Nordel is an established residential area; land trades as built house lots, strata units, and Social Heart assemblies/applications. No presale lot offering was verified.

faq.q: What does "bare-land strata" at Sunbury Terrace actually mean?
faq.a: You own a bare-land strata lot (Plan NWS2806 per a directory record) in a 12-unit, 1989 half-duplex-style community at 8376 Centre Street — you pay strata fees, follow the bylaws and get a Form B, but your lot is land with your home on it, which changes how lot-level responsibilities and insurance sit versus a conventional townhouse strata. Read the strata plan and bylaws, not just the Form B summary.

faq.q: Is Delta Gardens in Nordel, Scottsdale or Annieville?
faq.a: Listings use all three names for the one complex.

faq.q: Can a Nordel house lot add a suite, coach house or garden suite?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH framework (Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) permits small-scale multi-unit housing on all single-detached and duplex lots citywide, and Delta permits secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies — eligibility is parcel-specific.

faq.q: Is more supply coming to the Social Heart, and can I buy a lot in it?
faq.a: Two applications were active in the research — LU009689 (apartment and townhouse, 112 Street and 82 Avenue) and LU009611 (mixed-use, 112 Street and 84 Avenue), both inside ND12.
